title: Qt: Endpoints and Conversations last opened tabs
description:
A regression fix on handling the last opened tabs for the
Endpoint and Conversations dialogs, the implementation might
be different from the original idea.

Fix #18237

This leads to an exception with the trace attached to bug report #19869

The previous behavior when the current tab was unchecked was to hide the tab and the dialog picked another tab. This led to the crash in #18250 if the last protocol was unchecked.

With this it's not possible to uncheck the current tab (there's a small visual effect as it is re-selected) which does prevent that crash from happening.

However, if somehow the recent list of tabs *does* manage to become a null string, there is a null pointer dereference when the dialog is opened.
In this case, where the list obtained from the recentList is empty, should the updated default list be immediately written back to the recent list?

Yes it should, or we keep opening the dialog again and again and each time loading this default list without even saving when closing the main window. Unless one tab is added or removed.

To fix this, I'm pushing !17189

The last opened tab also doesn't changed if the new tab has no data; this is related to #18250, and is a symptom of the dialogs get tab-related information by querying the data in the tab's model, which works poorly when there are no rows.
